'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Steve Baroni LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Baroni''' / deck '''Foxwoods & HOOKERS'''. Line 1 '''Y4 Throne Room''' → start [[There Is Good In Him / Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]] (QA: earlier HFTMF inventory guess corrected).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
